title: Using network analysis for the prediction of treatment dropout in patients with mood and anxiety disorders: A methodological proof-of-concept study
limitations: - Small sample size; - High number of potential predictor variables (k = 68); - Unequal division of patients into completers and dropouts; - Limited assessment of treatment expectations with only one item.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code availability is not explicitly stated in the main text but is implied to be available upon request from the corresponding author. Data availability is explicitly stated as available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
